claims.claim: BIS released an interim final rule requiring a licence to ship advanced accelerators to any data centre worldwide providing more than 12 million aggregate TPP to companies headquartered in Macau or Country Group D:5, including China.
claims.episode_span: requiring a licence to ship advanced accelerators to any data centre worldwide that provides more than 12 million aggregate TPP
claims.source_title: U.S. Cracks Down on China Renting AI GPUs Through Overseas Data Centers
claims.supporting_quote: Under the new rule, a license is required to ship any advanced accelerators to any data center worldwide that provides more than 12 million "aggregate TPP" of computing power to companies headquartered in Macau or Country Group D:5, which includes China.

claims.claim: An H100 rates about 15,800 TPP, and the 12 million aggregate TPP cap equates to roughly 750 H100s or around 330 B200s.
claims.episode_span: an H100 rates about 15,800 TPP, so the cap is roughly 750 H100s or around 330 B200s
claims.source_title: U.S. Cracks Down on China Renting AI GPUs Through Overseas Data Centers
claims.supporting_quote: For example, an H100 rates about 15,800 TPP. "Aggregate TPP" sums up every accelerator in the facility, so the cap equates to roughly 750 H100s or around 330 B200s.

claims.claim: A licence is required to export advanced semiconductors to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil.
claims.episode_span: a licence is now required to export, re-export or transfer advanced semiconductors to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil
claims.source_title: US Moves To Block China’s Access To AI Data Centres
claims.supporting_quote: The rule says a licence will now be required to export, re-export or transfer advanced semiconductors to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand or Brazil, which it specified “present a higher-than-normal risk of diversion”.

claims.claim: Data centres already serving covered customers have 90 days to obtain a licence, and only commercial recommender systems are exempt.
claims.episode_span: Data centres already serving the covered customers have 90 days to obtain a licence.
claims.source_title: U.S. Cracks Down on China Renting AI GPUs Through Overseas Data Centers
claims.supporting_quote: Data centers already serving such customers have 90 days to obtain a license. Only "commercial recommender systems" are exempt, and anything that generates text, images, video, or code does not qualify.

claims.claim: BIS said the rule was written by and at the direction of the Treasury Department and the National Security Council.
claims.episode_span: BIS said the rule was written by and at the direction of the Treasury Department and the National Security Council.
claims.source_title: U.S. Cracks Down on China Renting AI GPUs Through Overseas Data Centers
claims.supporting_quote: Notably, BIS states that the rule was written by and at the direction of the Department of the Treasury and the National Security Council.

claims.claim: Nvidia announced Rubin HPC at SC26 in Chicago with more than 50,000 CUDA cores, sparse-data acceleration and seventh-generation NVLink, due in 2028.
claims.episode_span: a Vera Rubin-family GPU with more than 50,000 CUDA cores, hardware for sparse-data acceleration and seventh-generation NVLink, due in 2028
claims.source_title: Nvidia Rubin HPC GPU Unveiled at SC26 With 50,000+ CUDA Cores but No Memory Bandwidth Figure
claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia announced Rubin HPC on Monday at the SC26 supercomputing conference in Chicago : a new GPU in its Vera Rubin family with more than 50,000 CUDA cores , hardware for sparse data acceleration and seventh-generation NVLink, due in 2028.

claims.claim: The current Rubin tops out at 28,672 CUDA cores, and NVLink 7 retains 3.6 TB/s of per-GPU bandwidth already shipping on NVLink 6.
claims.episode_span: the current Rubin tops out at 28,672 CUDA cores, and that NVLink 7 keeps the 3.6 terabytes per second of per-GPU bandwidth
claims.source_title: Nvidia Teases Rubin HPC GPU: 50,000+ CUDA Cores, Ships 2028
claims.supporting_quote: The current Rubin tops out at 28,672 CUDA cores.

claims.claim: A Vera CPU rack of 192 CPUs, about 300 TB of memory and 1 PB of storage is described as arriving in early 2027.
claims.episode_span: a Vera CPU rack of 192 CPUs, about 300 terabytes of memory and 1 petabyte of storage, arriving in early 2027
claims.source_title: Nvidia Teases Rubin HPC GPU: 50,000+ CUDA Cores, Ships 2028
claims.supporting_quote: The Vera CPU rack (192-CPU, ~300TB memory, 1PB storage) arrives in early 2027, a full year before Rubin HPC ships.

claims.claim: On the June 2026 TOP500 list El Capitan posted 1.809 exaflops on LINPACK and 17.41 petaflops on HPCG.
claims.episode_span: El Capitan posted 1.809 exaflops on LINPACK and 17.41 petaflops on HPCG
claims.source_title: Nvidia Rubin HPC GPU Unveiled at SC26 With 50,000+ CUDA Cores but No Memory Bandwidth Figure
claims.supporting_quote: On the June 2026 list, El Capitan posted 1.809 exaflops on LINPACK and 17.41 petaflops on HPCG, while Fugaku posted 442 petaflops and 16.00 petaflops.

claims.claim: MLCommons published MLPerf Training v6.1 with 24 organizations, 153 systems and 250 results, 37 percent of systems in the cloud.

claims.claim: Qwen3.5-397B times were 10.44 minutes on Vera Rubin NVL72 at 1,024 GPUs, 18.02 minutes on 640 Ironwood TPUs, and 22.78 minutes on 256 GB200 GPUs.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia reports 10.44 minutes on Vera Rubin NVL72 at 1,024 GPUs, Google Cloud reports 18.02 minutes on 640 Ironwood TPUs
claims.source_title: MLPerf Training v6.1 Adds Post-Training Test; NVIDIA, Google, CoreWeave Results Not Comparable
claims.supporting_quote: The headline times for the new Qwen3.5-397B reinforcement learning test, 10.44 minutes on Rubin , 18.02 on Ironwood and 22.78 on a GB200 NVL72 system , came from clusters of different sizes that split their work differently

claims.claim: On DeepSeek-V3 at 1,024 GPUs Nvidia reports 4.14 minutes for Rubin and 8.03 minutes for GB300, and a 10,240-GPU GB300 cluster set 1.38 minutes.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia reports 4.14 minutes for Rubin and 8.03 minutes for GB300; a 10,240-GPU GB300 NVL72 cluster across 160 racks set the round’s fastest absolute time at 1.38 minutes
claims.source_title: MLPerf Training v6.1 Adds Post-Training Test; NVIDIA, Google, CoreWeave Results Not Comparable
claims.supporting_quote: On DeepSeek-V3 671B at 1,024 GPUs, the times were 4.14 minutes for Rubin and 8.03 minutes for GB300.
